boardRecommendation.decision: Continue the core business conditionally, but do not value it or calculate an earn-out from management's €312,000 profit claim.
causes: €90,000 of September deposits was recorded as August sales.
A €50,000 loan was mislabeled as income.
€18,000 bad debt, €22,000 damaged stock, €25,000 legal provision and €24,000 depreciation were omitted.
€80,000 of equipment was misclassified, while a €10,000 repair was capitalized.
€110,000 of personal owner spending was presented as business spending or payroll.
Payroll, supplier, interest and deposit liabilities were incomplete.
actions: Freeze owner-card access and add dual approval.
Reconcile inventory and dispose of damaged stock.
Investigate management override and source conflicts.
